sn30.4-6:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
sn30.4-6:1.3: ko nu kho bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā jalābujānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati …pe…
sn30.4-6:1.6: idha bhikkhu, ekacco kāyena dvayakārī hoti, vācāya dvayakārī, manasā dvayakārī.
sn30.4-6:1.10: “aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā opapātikānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya”nti.
sn30.4-6:1.11: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā opapātikānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
sn30.4-6:1.12: ayaṃ kho bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā opapātikānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
